sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: The Event class, implemented in Cython, is a specialized selection template within the AnalysisG framework, designed for generic event selection in Monte Carlo 16 (MC16) events. It inherits from the generic SelectionTemplate class, providing a foundational structure for event-level filtering. While its transform_dict_keys method is currently empty, it serves as a placeholder for potential future data exposure from the underlying C++ event selection logic.

sect1.title: The Event Class
sect1.para: Event is a cdef class, indicating its implementation as a Cython extension type. It inherits from SelectionTemplate, thereby gaining all the base functionalities for event selection, ROOT file interpretation, and weight management. Its primary role is to encapsulate a C++ event object, which likely contains the core logic for applying generic event-level selections.

listitem.para: __cinit__(self): The Cython "constructor" equivalent, called during object allocation. It initializes a new C++ event object and assigns its pointer to self.ptr. It then upcasts self.ptr to an event* and assigns it to self.tt for specialized access.
__init__(self): (Not explicitly defined in the provided snippet) This would typically be the Python initializer.
__dealloc__(self): The Cython "destructor" equivalent, called upon object deallocation. It deallocates the C++ event object pointed to by self.tt, ensuring proper memory management.

cdef void transform_dict_keys(self): This method is a placeholder from SelectionTemplate and is currently empty in this implementation. It is intended to be overridden by subclasses or to be populated if the underlying C++ event object exposes data that needs to be converted into Python dictionaries or lists.

sect1.title: C++ Interaction
sect1.para:
The Event class leverages Cython's capabilities for seamless C++ integration:
cdef class Event: Declares Event as a Cython extension type.
cdef event *tt: A C++ pointer to an event object, which is the specialized C++ implementation for event selections.
self.ptr = new event(): Initializes the base SelectionTemplate's C++ pointer.
self.tt = <event*>self.ptr: This line demonstrates C++ upcasting, allowing Event to fulfill the SelectionTemplate interface while internally managing its specific event data.
from AnalysisG.core.selection_template cimport SelectionTemplate: Imports the base SelectionTemplate class, from which Event inherits.
from AnalysisG.core.tools cimport as_dict, as_list: Imports utility functions for converting between C++ and Python data structures (though not used in the current transform_dict_keys).
